TCD.note: Only refugee document counts are given, not a share of the population enrolled.
Who operates or owns SIGPTS is not stated; ANATS is named only as responsible for issuing secure identity documents.
No public register is said to be keyed on the national ID number.

systems.system: SIGPTS (Integrated Population and Secure Documents Management System)

TCD.note: The NNIR is a refugee identification number issued in a World Bank-funded pilot; it is not stated as the general national ID system's issuance.

facts.fact: UNHCR says that in a World Bank-funded pilot started in N'Djamena, refugees are registered with biometric verification in Chad's SIGPTS and receive a National Refugee Identification Number, with more than 4,000 of a 7,000 target having received secure documents.
UNHCR says that with an NNIR refugees in Chad can now open bank accounts, register SIM cards, receive money transfers from abroad and access healthcare.
